description.description: The video frames show a large crowd gathered on a snowy residential street in Minneapolis. In the lower half of the split-screen view, a person in a tan jacket and black mask uses a long pole to hold up a burning American flag over a fire on the ground while onlookers record with their phones. The upper half of the frame appears to show a close-up profile of a person observing the scene from the crowd. Text overlays provide context about the event and location.
